overview: The Medford City Council met to issue warrants for the 2024 state election, approve Capital Stabilization Fund expenditures, and ordain ordinances on wildlife feeding and EV charging. The council also dedicated the meeting to the memory of late City Messenger Lawrence Lepore and acted on several utility petitions.

items.title: Sarah Bradley Fulton Day Resolution
items.summary: Approved paper 24479 encouraging residents to attend celebrations for Sarah Bradley Fulton Day.

items.title: Paper 24480
items.summary: Tabled paper 24480 to the next council meeting.

items.title: Approval of Records and Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved the records of previous meetings and reports of committees.

items.title: Memorial Resolution for City Messenger Lawrence Lepore
items.summary: Dedicated the meeting and observed a moment of silence in honor of late City Messenger Lawrence Lepore following tributes from councilors, staff, and residents.

items.title: 2024 State Election Call and Warrant
items.summary: Approved papers 24477 and 24478 establishing the election call, polling places, and official warrant for the state election on November 5, 2024.

items.title: National Grid Grant of Location on Hale Avenue
items.summary: Approved paper 24472 granting National Grid permission to install approximately 160 feet of gas main on Hale Avenue with engineering conditions.

items.title: National Grid Main Street Amendment Request
items.summary: Denied National Grid's request to amend pavement restoration requirements for a previously approved grant of location on Main Street.

items.title: Capital Stabilization Fund Appropriations
items.summary: Approved paper 24473 appropriating funds from the Capital Stabilization Fund for school water heater replacement, roadway patching, parking light poles, City Hall elevator repairs, and Brooks Estate maintenance.

items.title: Wildlife Feeding Ordinance
items.summary: Ordained paper 23449 upon third reading to regulate the feeding of wildlife in the city.

items.title: Electric Vehicle Charging Revolving Fund Ordinance
items.summary: Ordained paper 24458 upon third reading to establish an electric vehicle charging revolving fund.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Heard public comment regarding real estate tax exemption statutes before adjourning.
